papers.title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Dataset and Cosmological Inference Competition
papers.comment: 10+7 pages, 2+4 figures, 2+1 tables. Key results of the NeurIPS 2025 FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Challenge Phase 1. The challenge dataset is publicly available at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20056065. Challenge GitHub repository: https://github.com/FAIR-Universe/Cosmology_Challenge
papers.excerpt: Weak gravitational lensing is a powerful cosmological probe that enables direct mapping of the matter distribution and precise constraints on the fundamental parameters governing structure formation in the universe.

papers.title: Local Pitch Angles of Galactic Structures in Nearby Galaxies with JWST: II. Dust Lanes and Gas Flows in Bar-Dominated Systems
papers.excerpt: We present a spatially resolved study of local pitch angles in six barred spiral galaxies observed by PHANGS--JWST, focusing on bar-dominated regions where dust lanes are the main structures.

papers.title: Local Pitch Angles of Galactic Structures in Nearby Galaxies with JWST: I. Spiral Arms and Interarm Substructures in Disk-Dominated Systems
papers.excerpt: We present a spatially resolved study of spiral arms and feather substructures in seven nearby galaxies observed with JWST.

papers.title: Scalable early warning for binary neutron-star mergers in third-generation gravitational-wave detectors
papers.excerpt: Third-generation gravitational-wave observatories will observe binary neutron-star coalescences for hours before merger.

papers.title: Classical Cepheids in the 4MOST era I: Methodology for 4MOST variable stars and NLTE abundance gradients in the Milky Way
papers.comment: 24 pages, 19 figures, Accepted for publication by A&A
papers.excerpt: Classical Cepheids (CCs) are key distance indicators and tracers of young stellar populations in the Milky Way.

papers.title: Multi-phase Carbon Structure and Dynamics in NGC 6334: Insights from CO, [C I], and [C II]
papers.comment: 12+10 pages, 23 figures, Accepted for publication in A&A
papers.excerpt: We present high-angular and velocity resolution observations of the emission lines of [CII] at 158 micron, [CI] at 609 micron, and the 12CO and 13CO (J=3-2) transitions toward the central region of NGC 6334, providing a detailed multi-phase view of carbon in...

papers.title: Advances in High-Precision Astrometry for Exoplanet Detection for Astrometric Missions
papers.journal_ref: International Conference in Space Optics 2026, Kyriaki Minoglou, ESA/ESTEC; Karine Mathieu, CNES; Nikos Karafolas, ESA/ESTEC; Fr{é}d{é}ric Bernard, CNES, Oct 2026, Sorrento, Italy
papers.excerpt: High-precision astrometry is a cornerstone for detecting Earth-like exoplanets in the habitable zones of nearby solar-type stars and probing the nature of dark matter in galactic environments.

papers.title: Mathematical foundations and numerical simulations of BDNK hydrodynamics: from heavy-ion collisions to astrophysics
papers.excerpt: We present new developments in the mathematical foundations and numerical simulations of the causal and stable first-order relativistic viscous hydrodynamic theory by Bemfica, Disconzi, Noronha, and Kovtun (BDNK) in general spacetimes.

papers.title: Through Ups and Downs: the Transient Lensing Behaviour of SIDM halos undergoing Core Collapse
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures. Submitted for publication in MNRAS
papers.excerpt: Self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) haloes can become extremely dense following gravothermal core collapse, motivating their use as explanations for unusually concentrated gravitational lenses.

papers.title: New optimisations for exact, scalable 2D Gaussian process inference, with applications to astronomical time-series
papers.excerpt: Astronomical datasets often consist of a grid of datapoints in two or more dimensions, such as images, spectroscopic time-series, and imaging time-series.

papers.title: InstantHMR : Real-Time Human Mesh Recovery on Your Phone
papers.excerpt: Real-time 3D human mesh recovery from a single image on mobile devices is a challenging problem with many applications, including robotics, biomechanics, AR/VR, and exergames.

papers.title: A pipeline for identifying astrophysical signals and instrumental glitches in LISA data
papers.excerpt: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) is a space-based gravitational wave detector scheduled for launch in the 2030s by the European Space Agency.
